title: Lumina Residence
brief: A two-story residential home designed for modern family life, integrating work, study, and leisure spaces with a unique layout and natural materials.

spaces.purpose: Open-plan living and dining area with natural light and flexible seating arrangements.
Integrated kitchen and home office with ample storage and ergonomic workstations.
Master bedroom with private en-suite bathroom and walk-in closet.
Multi-functional children's studio with play, study, and sleeping areas.
